name: Spear Launcher

source.title: Pathfinder Adventure: The Fall of Plaguestone

disable: Thievery (trained) on the rope allows a PC to tie the rope off and open the door without setting off the trap.

items.name: Spear
items.text:
Trigger The rope is cut or otherwise untied from the door

---

Effect The trap makes an attack against the creature that manipulated the rope

text: An old heavy crossbow is hidden in a pile of trash, loaded with a wooden spear, and connected to the rope holding the door.
